key_concepts: Force can be exerted without touching an object, as with a magnet
Magnets attract materials made of iron, nickel, and cobalt
Materials lacking these metals, such as wood, plastic, and cloth, are non-magnetic
Earth acts as a large magnet with magnetic north and south
Magnet strength varies and depends on size and aligned magnetic domains
Magnets have two poles: north and south
Like poles repel and opposite poles attract
Magnets can lose magnetism over time through demagnetization
Cutting a permanent magnet in half produces two smaller magnets
Many everyday objects contain magnets, including speakers, cell phones, and refrigerator m
Magnetic force acts within the magnetic field around a magnet
Magnets are used in technologies such as maglev trains, MRI machines, and electric motors
